Meta plans AI chip production to boost computing capacity

Meta Platforms is reportedly planning to begin production of its custom AI chip, codenamed Iris, in September. The chip, developed with partners Broadcom and TSMC, aims to significantly increase the company's computing capacity. This development follows a notable surge in Meta's stock price.
